verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a quickstart that uses Claude and plain-language prompts to go from source file to structured output (unstructured-docs-2, unstructured-docs-40). It also ships a first-party Transform MCP server that lets AI tools such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI drive ingestion, partitioning, enrichment, chunking and embedding (unstructured-docs-22, unstructured-docs-17, unstructured-docs-51). Natural-language operation therefore works, but only through external AI clients, and the documented MCP scope covers transforming local files. Missing for 10: a native built-in natural-language interface, evidence of natural-language control over workflows, connectors and jobs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
